content: Yi hakana ni, tuzakukenu muna bikuma bya theti bya malongi matadidini Kidisitu. Tuvutukilaku hika malongi mana ma kisina hanga tsobuka ya mbundu ku mambu matadidini mihangu myafwa yi lukwikilu mwena Nzambi,
malongi matadidini mbotika yi kuthetika kwa moku, pfutumuka ya bafwa yi pfundusu ya kimakulu.
Amana bwabuna twahánga, ho Nzambi kazolabwa.
Kikuma batu babana bábayinika ku mwini wa Nzambi mbala yikwawu, bálekita ku kabu dya ku zilu, bátambula Kitembu Kyatoma hakimosi yi bakwawu,
Bálekita ndinga ya bukheti ya Nzambi yi ngolu zilutini za tsi yina yakwísa.
Babwini muna luzingu lwa bawu lwa khulu! Bwalendakanaku mu kubanata ku tsobuka ya pha ya mbundu. Mukuma, Mwana wa Nzambi babati vutula hika ha kitakani amana babati mulewula ha mesu ma batu.
Kikuma, yuka ni mvula kakotaka mu mafu kosu tangwa, amana kamenisaka miti mya mupfunu kwena babana bakunimya, disongidila ni mafu mamana, Nzambi wásakumunama.
Kaasi ho mamenisa bivunza bya tsaku yi kisoma, mákalaku mupfunu; amana ka thama ku babundilama kwena Nzambi amana tsuka tsuka kuyokama.
Yi hakana, keti bweti, tuzonzi bwabuna kaasi baphangi bama batondama, tusini mbundu ni kima kimosi kya tsambu kibati luhingila, luhulusu.
Kikuma Nzambi keku kayengu. Amana kazímbakanaku muhangu wenu, keti lungongu luna lusongidini kikuma kya zina dyandi, ha lwádikotisa mu kusadila bakwikidi tuka thama yi buthwena bwabu.
Kaasi tuzodi ni kosu mutu wa benu kasongila tsambu meni zazina tii yi kuna tsuka, ndangu kivuvu kyenu kyamonika kyabasa.
Ndangu lukitukaku bamolu, kaasi sokululenu babana bisi bonga kuvwa kuna kásila Nzambi muna lukwikilu yi kikwamina.
Kilangi kya Nzambi kyisiku lwesa
Tangwa kásila Nzambi kilangi kwena Bulahami, bwosu kwákalaku zina dya mutu wa mbuta mwena dina káfwana mu kudila ndefi, yi hana kádila ndefi muna zina dya yandi meni.
Wázimbula: «Kyedika, yikúsakumuna buna bufwani amana yivúdisa butuka dyaku.»
Yi hakana ni Bulahami mu kikwamina, wánona kina kásila Nzambi.
Kinga, batu ha bisi dya ndefi muna zina dya mutu wuna wubahitini bawu mu lukumu, amana ndefi yayina yisi tabula tendu dyosu.
Muna phila yayina, Nzambi kázola ni kasongila wengele kwena babana bafwana mu kubonga mamboti ma kilangi ni ndefi yandi yisiku katuka; yi hakana kádila ndefi ku kilangi kyandi.

Yi hakana, muna mambu modi mafwaniku mu kusoba, bwalendakanaku kwena Nzambi mu kuhuna. Yi hakana ni, thwenina yi kikesa kya lawu, betu baba thwenina yi kiswaminu kimosi: kubonga kivuvu kina bátusila.
Kivuvu kyakina kikuma kya betu kyenina hanga kikokolu kya ngolu yi kya mukwandi kya moya wetu. Kyisi lobuka amana kihiti kibwiku kya kizika kyatoma hedila.
Yi hakana meni kákotila Yesu ku thwala ya betu yi kikuma kya betu, mu kuyata kanga ku mesu ma betu, wákituka mbuta-nganga mu kimakulu muna kanga dya Medikiseteki.
